assets.title: Muffled Distant Explosion
assets.author: NenadSimic
assets.license_evidence: Author asset page explicitly identifies NenadSimic and CC0; description says low pitched log drum hit with delayed reverberation. See content/licenses/explosion-license-evidence.json.
assets.required_attribution: Muffled Distant Explosion by NenadSimic (CC0-1.0), trimmed/resampled for RED HORIZON. Recorded log-drum explosion surrogate, not a detonation field recording. Credit provided voluntarily.
assets.processing: ffmpeg -i source.wav -t 4 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -af volume=0.8,afade=t=out:st=3.5:d=0.5 -f s16le explosion.pcm; tools/audio_assets.py offline reproducibility
assets.limitation: Recording-derived log-drum effect with author reverberation; not actual bomb/tank/artillery/aircraft destruction recording. All explosion roles currently share one surrogate.

assets.title: Footsteps / 01-footstep.ogg
assets.author: GboxMikeFozzy
assets.license_evidence: Author upload dated2022-04-14 explicitly linksCC0; author describes recording their own walk through a subway. Reviewed2026-10-05; evidence content/licenses/footstep-license-evidence.json.
assets.required_attribution: Footsteps recording by GboxMikeFozzy (CC0-1.0), attenuated and faded for RED HORIZON. Credit provided voluntarily.
assets.processing: ffmpeg -i source.ogg -ac1 -ar48000 -af volume=0.6,afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.005,afade=t=out:st=0.144:d=0.01 -f s16le; tools/footstep_assets.py offline conversion
assets.limitation: One recorded subway hard-surface footfall; all terrain shares it. No terrain-specific variations, footwear layers or army footstep aggregation.
